old_results_included: none; current frozen-data result set only

rules.neat_ep_absolute_tasks: Primary formal absolute-property evaluation is baseline-inclusive. Valid neat EP rows are retained; on neat EP rows, FR-derived molecular/fingerprint/composition/synergy/interaction features are masked, and the task-matching EP_matrix feature is masked where present. Overall metrics are primary and modified-formulation test-subset metrics are sensitivity analysis.
rules.delta_tasks: Neat EP is a baseline/reference source but is not a Delta target. Explicit Loading_total_FR=0 rows are excluded from Delta target evaluation; rows with unknown loading are retained only when the Delta target is valid.
rules.strict_validation: FINAL evaluation uses 5x5 molecule-grouped nested CV with fold-internal preprocessing. Task-specific feature view/K are predefined from development-stage V4 sensitivity analyses; only the predictive model is selected by grouped inner CV within each outer-training fold.
rules.paper_screening_policy: final manuscript screening uses the combined designed+PubChem candidate pool; 50 kW/m2 is the primary cone-flux scenario and 35 kW/m2 is sensitivity analysis; final_priority_combined is the final priority source
rules.paper_output_policy: Main text uses FINAL fixed-view/K baseline-inclusive 5x5 molecule-grouped nested validation; overall metrics are primary, modified-formulation subset metrics are sensitivity analysis, and development repeated-group-holdout or curated/modified-only results must not silently replace FINAL results.
rules.modified_only_role: sensitivity/subset evaluation; not the primary formal absolute-property result
rules.preparation_method_encoding: Preparation_Method has four canonical nominal categories. Modeling uses one-hot encoding only; Preparation_Method_num is retained as a record-management code and is not an ordinal predictive feature. Preparation/Synergy FR-derived categorical features are neutralized on neat-EP rows.
rules.delta_definition: All stored Delta fields are recalculated as DeltaY = Y_modified_FR/EP - Y_matched_neat_EP whenever both values are available. Neat-EP rows are reference rows and are excluded from formal Delta targets.
rules.element_content_definition: P/N/S/B/Si_content wt% are formulation-level elemental contents. Legacy *_loading_real engineered features are Loading_total_FR × elemental_content / 100 interaction terms and must not be interpreted as a second elemental-loading calculation.

molecule_identity_rule: full-component canonical SMILES; salts/multicomponent structures preserve all components and stoichiometry
results_status: Audited data/feature release finalized. FINAL manuscript-facing results were regenerated and audited under FINAL_FIXED_BASELINE_INCLUSIVE_5X5.
